title: Tsunami Travel Time Maps — August 27, 1883 Krakatau
creator: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
provenance: NOAA/NCEI tsunami travel-time reference for the August 27, 1883 Krakatau event.
notes: Distinguishes direct tsunami propagation from remote water-level disturbances plausibly excited by atmospheric gravity waves where continental shadowing precluded direct tsunami travel.
